name: M3_MWS121MI_LstAcqByDmdOrd
description: List acquisition preallocations linked to a specific demand order line and see which supply orders cover that demand. The operation returns all preallocated acquisition order lines connected to the entered demand order category, order number, and line (optionally line suffix). The response includes company, warehouse, item, demand and acquisition order identities, several quantity fields related to the preallocation, planning date, pre‑allocatable net quantity, expiration date, and schedule number, enabling analysis and integration with production or packing processes. It only reads existing preallocations and does not change any data.

inputParameters.name: DOCA
inputParameters.description: Demand order category identifying the type of demand order whose preallocated acquisition orders are listed.

inputParameters.name: DRDN
inputParameters.description: Demand order number specifying the demand order whose preallocated acquisition orders to list.

inputParameters.name: DRDL
inputParameters.description: Demand order line number specifying the line on the demand order whose preallocated acquisition orders to list.

inputParameters.name: DRDX
inputParameters.description: Optional line suffix identifying a specific sequence within the demand order line to use as a filter.

inputParameters.name: AOCA
inputParameters.description: Acquisition order category used to restrict the list to preallocations from a specific type of acquisition order, such as purchase or manufacturing.

inputParameters.name: ARDN
inputParameters.description: Acquisition order number used to restrict the list to preallocations from a specific acquisition order.

inputParameters.name: ARDL
inputParameters.description: Acquisition order line number used to restrict the list to preallocations from a specific line on the acquisition order.

inputParameters.name: ARDX
inputParameters.description: Acquisition order line suffix used to restrict the list to a specific sequence within the acquisition order line.

inputParameters.name: NFTR
inputParameters.description: Number of leading key fields from the input that are used as filters when selecting records.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the preallocation record linking the demand and acquisition orders.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the preallocated acquisition order line is held or planned.

outputParameters.name: DOCA
outputParameters.description: Demand order category of the demand order in the preallocation.

outputParameters.name: DRDN
outputParameters.description: Demand order number for the preallocated demand order.

outputParameters.name: DRDL
outputParameters.description: Demand order line number for the preallocated demand line.

outputParameters.name: DRDX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the specific sequence within the demand order line.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number on the preallocated acquisition and demand order lines.

outputParameters.name: AOCA
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order category of the supplying order in the preallocation.

outputParameters.name: ARDN
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order number of the supplying order linked to the demand.

outputParameters.name: ARDL
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order line number for the supplying order line linked to the demand.

outputParameters.name: ARDX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the specific sequence within the acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity on the acquisition order line in the item's basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PQTT
outputParameters.description: Total quantity already preallocated on the acquisition order line across all demand lines.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when this preallocation affects the material plan.

outputParameters.name: PANQ
outputParameters.description: Net quantity on the acquisition order line that is still available for preallocation.

outputParameters.name: PQTY
outputParameters.description: Preallocated quantity promised from the acquisition order line to this demand order line.

outputParameters.name: EXPI
outputParameters.description: Expiration date after which the item lot can no longer be used.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number associated with the preallocated acquisition order for production planning.
